test_title: PYST 37: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Correct the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No correct' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

Life would be a __burdened without__ good companionship.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the** incorrect form** of the word **"burdened."**
 
• The word** "burdened"** is an adjective and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct word should be **"burden,"** which is a noun and** fits the context properly.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in the underlined part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Life would be a** burden **without good companionship."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "No correct"** – This option is incorrect because the original sentence contains an error.
 
• **Option 3: "burdens without"** – This option is incorrect because "burdens" (a verb) does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "burdening without"** – This option is incorrect because "burdening" (a verb) does not fit the context of the sentence.
